description: A minimal tile matrix set element for use within a list of tile matrix sets linking to a full definition.

oneOf.description: Simplification of the object into a url if the other properties are not present

uri.description: Reference to one coordinate reference system (CRS)

allOf.description: An object defining the CRS using the JSON encoding for Well-known text representation of coordinate reference systems 2.0

referenceSystem.description: A reference system data structure as defined in the MD_ReferenceSystem of the ISO 19115

id.description: Optional local tile matrix set identifier, e.g. for use as unspecified `{tileMatrixSetId}` parameter. Implementation of 'identifier'

links.description: Links to related resources. A 'self' link to the tile matrix set definition is required.

title.description: Title of this tile matrix set, normally used for display to a human

uri.description: Reference to an official source for this tileMatrixSet
